text.p: Fidelity Investments said Monday it will add, effective November 15, an additional 161 mutual funds from 41 companies to its FundsNetwork.

The additional funds will bring the total number of mutual funds available without paying a transaction fee to Fidelity to 621 from 91 fund families. Fidelity said with the additional funds will offer its customers more investment choices than any other mutual fund marketplace -- more than 3,300 funds from over 300 fund companies.
"Fidelity is responding to customer demand for more funds through additional fund families," Sam Jenson, vice president, Fidelity FundsNetwork, said in a release.
